title: nhl20
note:
R43 — PS4 GNF header census, one checkpoint file per title (read-only; headers + file sizes only). Restores the 2026-09-21 handoff 15
pitch-rounding check as a full-population probe (no sample) and separates the coverage classes the R1 review asked for.

Per `.gnf` under `<CUSA>/databigs/Extracted`: the 256-byte GNF header (`GNF ` magic, contentsSize, version/count/alignment, streamSize) and
the T# words as Studio's `tdb-rx2::gnf` splits them (width / height 14-bit, dfmt 6-bit, nfmt, base / last level, tiling, type, pitch 14-bit,
depth), dword 7 and the 16 bytes after the T#. Classes per file (mutually exclusive, in this order):
  not_gnf            magic missing / header shorter than 0x40
  cube_or_array      type != 9 (2D) or depth != 0 or data == 6 x the 2D prediction
  unknown_format     dfmt not in the block / uncompressed byte tables (BC6H 0x28 stays separate: tested with a 16-byte-block hypothesis)
  predicted          data-size rule evaluated: pass / fail counted separately
Rules tested on every readable file: streamSize == file size (or the concatenated streams tile the file — NHL 15 ships 1 115 two-stream files, found 2026-09-21 pm; the size rules are then evaluated on the first stream); d7 == file size - 0x100; pitch == roundup(w, 32) - 1 for block formats
(and == w - 1 for uncompressed); last_level + 1 <= floor(log2(max(w, h))) + 1; data == sum over levels of 8x8-block micro-tiles (tiling 13).
Field-bound census (representable vs shipped): max width / height / pitch / last_level seen per title.
Usage: python r43_gnf_header_census_per_title.py <out_dir> --titles nhl20[,nhl15,...] [--max N]
  -> <out_dir>/r43-gnf-<title>.json per title (a title's file is written only when its walk completes).
